method: curl (multi-UA) + HTML/CSS deep analysis + GitHub issue cross-reference
anti_duplicate_note: Previous tests: 0630 (EN i18n + responsive structure), 0600 (search/category/PDP responsive), 0445 (vendor/pricing). THIS test: Exclusively focuses on verifying open responsive issue #675 (mobile search 88px overflow) and its CSS-level remediation status, with cross-reference to PR #645 deployed code.
scenario: Verification of OPEN responsive issue #675 — Mobile search results listing layout scroll (88px overflow at 375px). CSS analysis of PR #645 fix deployment status.

issue_tested.title: HIGH: Mobile search results listing layout scroll — 88px document overflow at 375px

pr_645_deployed.evidence: CSS extracted from live production listing.css shows off-canvas sidebar at ≤991px

desktop_992px_plus.risk: NONE — adequate space for both columns

tablet_768_991px.layout: flex row: sidebar OFF-CANVAS (position:fixed, out-of-flow) + content (flex:1)
tablet_768_991px.risk: LOW — sidebar out of flex flow, single child content should fit

mobile_575_767px.layout: Same as tablet + grid goes to 2 columns

mobile_375_574px.layout: Same + grid goes to 1 column, list images go 100% width
mobile_375_574px.risk: LOW — single column should fit 375px viewport

overflow_x_hidden.verdict: CAUTION — This clips overflow instead of preventing it. Content may be hidden from users without causing scrollbar.
overflow_x_hidden.recommendation: Consider removing overflow-x:hidden and fixing root cause. Currently masks issues.

max_width_100.verdict: GOOD — Prevents the flex container from exceeding viewport

min_width_0_on_content.verdict: GOOD — Prevents flex content from overflowing due to min-content sizing

flex_direction_row.breakpoints: No @media rule changes flex-direction to column at any breakpoint
flex_direction_row.risk_assessment: Currently SAFE because sidebar is position:fixed (out of flow), leaving only 1 flex child. But fragile — if sidebar position:fixed ever breaks or is removed, overflow returns immediately.
flex_direction_row.recommendation: ADD: @media (max-width: 991px) { .zcnc-listings-layout { flex-direction: column; } } as defensive fallback

overflow_x_hidden_masks_reality.risk: If other content (ads, widgets, injected elements) overflows, it will be clipped silently without scrollbar
overflow_x_hidden_masks_reality.recommendation: Use overflow-x:clip instead of overflow-x:hidden for better containment, or remove and fix root causes

zcnc-row-info_overflow.html_structure: zcnc-listing-row uses flex layout inside cards
zcnc-row-info_overflow.verdict: Properly handles mobile layout — images and content stack vertically

pagination.verdict: Thinner page-link (min-width:34px) but no tap-target minimum (44px WCAG). Risk of tap-target failure.

browser_unavailability.issue: Playwright cannot launch: missing libnspr4.so, libnss3.so, libatk-1.0.so.0, libcups.so.2, libxkbcommon.so.0, libasound.so.2
browser_unavailability.impact: Cannot perform REAL visual verification at 375px viewport to confirm #675 is resolved
browser_unavailability.fix: Install system deps: apt-get install -y libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2
